      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test edits merely adapt existing harnesses and unit tests to the script verification API change rather than touching test infrastructure."
    },

      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Consensus and modifies src/script/interpreter.{h,cpp} and src/validation.cpp.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR removes an error-prone stateful reinitialization pattern in PrecomputedTransactionData that allowed instances to be partially reinitialized or reused across transactions, and avoids allocating unused txdata during assumevalid block connection."
    },

      "name": "wallet",
